title: Unlearning at Scale: State-Exact Trace-Preserving Deletion in Billion-Parameter Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.12220v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a prospectively instrumented training continuation reproduce a deletion counterfactual exactly after selected examples leave its replay dataset? We study a trace-preserving counterfactual that fixes recorded execution controls while assigning requested identifiers zero contribution. The guarantee is prospective: the original run must record this execution provenance and retain an eligible uncontaminated checkpoint. Under pinned single-GPU environments, replay from a token store materialized without the requested rows reconstructs a separately executed trace oracle bit-for-bit in model and optimizer state. Pythia 160M is exact across four deletion geometries; Pythia 2.8B matches all 2,775,208,960 model-state elements for a random 5% request; and Llama 3.2 1B is exact after omitting 400 of 4,000 TOFU examples from replay storage. These results establish billion-parameter state exactness. They do not establish cheap deletion,

translated_title: 大规模反学习：十亿参数语言模型中的状态精确与痕迹保持删除
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2508.12220v2 公告类型：交叉替换。摘要：一项前瞻性仪器化的训练延续能否在选定示例离开其重放数据集后，精确复现删除的反事实？我们研究了一种痕迹保持的反事实，它固定了记录的执行控制，同时为请求的标识符分配零贡献。该保证是前瞻性的：原始运行必须记录这种执行来源，并保留一个合格的未污染检查点。在固定的单GPU环境下，从没有请求行的令牌存储重放，可以逐位重构单独执行的痕迹预言机，在模型和优化器状态上均一致。Pythia 160M在四种删除几何形状下精确匹配；Pythia 2.8B在随机5%请求下匹配所有2,775,208,960个模型状态元素；Llama 3.2 1B在从重放存储中省略4,000个TOFU示例中的400个后精确匹配。这些结果确立了十亿参数状态精确性。它们并未确立廉价删除。
tldr: 本文提出一种痕迹保持的删除方法，通过记录执行来源并重放未污染检查点，实现十亿参数模型在删除示例后状态逐位精确匹配，但成本不低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trace-preserving deletion method that, by recording execution provenance and replaying uncontaminated checkpoints, achieves bit-for-bit state exactness in billion-parameter models after example deletion, albeit not cheaply.
